description: Minutes approval workflow: submit, approve (issue), return, correct.
precondition: Minutes in the needed status; approver and secretary actors.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Chair.
Revision WaitingApproval with UpdatedAt T; the caller read it at T.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the waiting revision; actor: the current Chair; reason: "Bổ sung kết luận của mục 2."; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Status Rejected with the reason, ReturnedBy = the Chair and ReturnedAt = now; 200 MSG430.
cases.log: Saved: status, reason, returner and times; notification "Biên bản bị trả lại" to the current Secretary ("Chủ toạ đã trả lại biên bản cuộc họp "…" Xem lý do trên tab Biên bản."); realtime minutes-changed push to the meeting's readers.
cases.note: UC-65 · BR-406 · BR-407 · MSG430 · Deviation: success also emits a realtime minutes-changed push (working-tree change).
